baseline-corpus.title: The first runs, saved before the experiments began
baseline-corpus.description: 39 runs saved between May and early July 2026: our first council, a second version of it, gpt-oss-20B alone and as a whole council, and a few reference runs with Claude Opus.
baseline-corpus.why: These runs came before the numbered cells. They were saved while the council was first being built, to see how it behaved and how it compared with a single model. They are kept here because they hold complete conversations from the project's earliest setups.
baseline-corpus.found:
There were no expectations and there is no result, only saved runs. Each run keeps the whole conversation: the question, the planning step, every specialist's instructions and draft, and the editor's final answer.

The setups are the first council (Phi-4 14B as editor, with Med42, Saul and Qwen-Open-Finance as specialists), a second council with different specialists, gpt-oss-20B answering alone with and without extra instructions, gpt-oss-20B filling every council role, and 2 runs each of Claude Opus alone and as a council.
baseline-corpus.means: Nothing was decided from these runs on their own. Open the Data tab to read them.
